newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit off high, but in range on dlr strength.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit off high, but in range on dlr strength.

text.p: The ringgit was off morning highs but within a 40-point range at the close of trading in Kuala Lumpur as the continued strength of dollar pressured regional currencies lower, dealers said on Thursday.
They said continued demand for the ringgit against the Singapore dollar prevented a sharper decline of the Malaysian unit, which has risen nearly 100 points since Monday.
In the morning, the ringgit was higher against the dollar due to fresh shift of funds from the Singapore dollar to ringgit.
"A lot of people are looking to cover their short (dollar) positions because dollar/majors are strong," said the head of dealing at a foreign bank in Malaysia.
He said the market was thin and choppy as many dealers were still away after the holidays for Chinese Lunar New Year and Moslem Eid al-Fitr festivals.
Dealers said the market would return to normal next week when the ringgit was expected to make fresh gains.
At 1000 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4850/60 a dollar. It was at 1.7515/34 a Singapore dollar.
